why: The verifier brief puts stricter checks into its pass/fail items and has no Advisory heading. Item 4 requires a mutation test ("mutate lint() … confirm a test would fail, then revert") and a package-lock consistency check; expect line 4 asks for neither. Item 6 adds a branch-name rule ("<type>/<issue>-<slug>, no claude/ prefix, under 60 chars") and a file-scope rule ("no extra files … diff is limited to this tool plus README/lock changes"); expect line 6 asks for neither. Item 2 adds "nothing on stdout," which expect line 2 doesn't say. Item 1 adds "but counted in numbering" for blank lines, which goes beyond expect line 1's words. All of these feed the per-item pass/fail verdict instead of sitting under Advisory, so the criterion fails.
